title: Copyrights
summary: Territory-by-territory rights representation for authors and publishers, from first submission to signed contract.
body:
We represent translation rights on behalf of authors, estates and publishers. That means building a submission plan for each title, matching it to editors who are actually buying in that category, negotiating the deal, and then keeping the paperwork honest for as long as the licence runs.

Every title on our list is handled by a named agent with a defined territory. Nothing is submitted blind.
